hypotheses.R0_state_routes_mask: A router from eight Layer-8 state PCs reaches median finite fidelity >=0.95 and 10th percentile >=0.80 on held-out FineWeb and WikiText.
hypotheses.R1_diagnostics_route_mask: A router from eight PCs of singleton/leaveout/energy diagnostics reaches the same thresholds.
hypotheses.R2_combined_router: Combining both feature sets reaches the thresholds and improves 10th-percentile fidelity by at least 0.05 over each component on at least one corpus.
hypotheses.R3_linear_address_is_insufficient: Every learned router has 10th-percentile fidelity below 0.50 on either corpus despite passing identity and training-fit checks.
